episodes.title: Pour It Out
episodes.summary: Amid prying eyes, Maddie tries to move on from Bill's fall from grace. Dana Sue deals with problems in her kitchen. Helen makes a life-altering purchase.

episodes.title: A United Front
episodes.summary: Maddie confers with Coach Cal about Tyler's struggles on and off the baseball field, and Helen works to put a devastated family back together.

episodes.title: Give Drink to the Thirsty
episodes.summary: While delays plague the trio's renovation plans, Maddie strikes a deal with Bill, Dana Sue stresses out over work and home, and Kyle opens up to Noreen.

episodes.title: Lay It All Down
episodes.summary: The town's tongues start wagging over Maddie's new friend, Dana Sue suffers a health scare, and Helen takes a legal threat personally.

episodes.title: Dance First, Think Later
episodes.summary: Mother Nature, a clumsy contractor and Maddie's longtime rival conspire to throw the spa's big opening into chaos. Tyler helps Annie out of a jam.

episodes.title: All Best Intentions
episodes.summary: Maddie worries about prying eyes when she's with Cal, a humiliated Annie feels betrayed by Tyler, and Bill surprises the kids with a special request.

episodes.title: Hold My Hand
episodes.summary: Maddie's coziness with Cal causes complications, Helen fights for a mock trial student, Noreen receives a welcome visitor, and Erik bonds with Isaac.

episodes.title: What Fools These Mortals Be
episodes.summary: As Bill makes a series of bad decisions that impact those closest to him, Noreen attends Kyle's play and Maddie takes a big step forward with Cal.

episodes.title: Where You Find Me
episodes.summary: On the morning of the mock trial, Kyle's behavior worries everyone. Meanwhile, Dana Sue sparks a connection with a handsome farmer.

episodes.title: Storms and Rainbows
episodes.summary: As prom night approaches, Maddie comes to a decision about Cal, Dana Sue scrambles to secure her future, and Helen calls an emergency margarita session.

episodes.title: Casseroles and Casualties
episodes.summary: In the waiting room, the families gather for news from the doctors, and Ty's plans for the season change. Over margaritas, Helen shares an announcement.

episodes.title: So Much to Say
episodes.summary: Helen helps Isaac in his search for answers, Dana Sue's restaurant hits a financial hiccup, and Maddie tries to find out what happened with her son.

episodes.title: The More Things Change
episodes.summary: While Coach Cal and Ty work through disappointments, a new kind of heartbreak hits Helen, and Dana Sue gets a late-night visitor on her front porch.

episodes.title: Walk of Faith
episodes.summary: The questions keep coming as Maddie investigates the lot behind the spa and Helen looks for clues in what Isaac's birth mother left behind.

episodes.title: Great Expectations
episodes.summary: Dana Sue's relationships become the talk of Serenity social media. Maddie uncovers who's behind the town's parking problem — bless their hearts.

episodes.title: Find It in Your Heart
episodes.summary: When the mayor won't see them, the Magnolias take their plans to the next level. At karaoke, Helen and Erik give the town something to talk about.

episodes.title: Fragile Things
episodes.summary: New beginnings abound as Serenity welcomes Noreen's baby, Isaac's birth mother tells him her whole story, and Erik reveals his painful past to Helen.

episodes.title: The Rules of the Game
episodes.summary: As the recall petition quickly picks up steam, Maddie and Cal attend a black-tie charity fundraiser and Ronnie presses Dana Sue to make up her mind.

episodes.title: Dear Heart
episodes.summary: Friends gather to plan a celebration of life. Meanwhile, counseling is off to a rocky start for Ronnie and Dana Sue, and Isaac meets his birth father.

episodes.title: If Thou Wilt, Remember
episodes.summary: More than margaritas are shaken up as Cal's past resurfaces, an unsavory acquaintance returns to Serenity, and Helen faces a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Meaning to Tell You
episodes.summary: After the incident at the restaurant, an unlikely ally offers to help Cal. Helen shares her painful secret and Maddie grills Ty about a rumor.

episodes.title: Meet Me Where I Am
episodes.summary: Erik opens up to Isaac while Helen ponders her future. Over margaritas, Maddie reveals the deal she made with Cal. Dana Sue and Ronnie plan a party.

episodes.title: The Searchers
episodes.summary: The competition heats up and the friendly trash talk flies as Serenity gathers for the Forager Festival. A vengeful Kathy cooks up a couple of schemes.

episodes.title: Be Bold
episodes.summary: Peggy digs into the mayor's activities after his announcement. Dana Sue learns the reason behind Miss Frances' gift. Helen gives CeCe another option.

episodes.title: On This Foundation
episodes.summary: Mary Vaughn drops a bombshell on Bill and Kyle. Annie has the shindig of her dreams — until a party crasher arrives. Erik meets a Serenity newcomer.

episodes.title: And a Star to Steer Her By
episodes.summary: Friends rally around Harlan after a crisis. Maddie and Dana Sue hire an esthetician. While at odds with the Magnolias, Helen receives heartbreaking news.

episodes.title: Somebody I'm Longing to See
episodes.summary: A devastated Helen finds comfort in her family away from Serenity. Bill hopes to be more involved in Rebecca's life. Dana Sue walks into a total mess.

episodes.title: Beat Me at My Own Game
episodes.summary: Ronnie gives Kathy what she wants, but it comes at a steep price. Erik meets Jeremy and comes to a realization. The kids rally to restore a playground.

episodes.title: A Game of Telephone
episodes.summary: An ex brings tensions and more to the table during a dinner with Maddie and Cal. Kyle deals with a secret admirer. Dana Sue has a change of party plans.

episodes.title: Save My Place
episodes.summary: Erik makes a decision about his future. Miss Paula announces her new plan. The town turns out to celebrate a happy couple, but an unwanted guest appears.

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Veil
episodes.summary: Bubbly in hand, the Magnolias toast to the future. The restaurant hosts an elegant event, and a festive Halloween party conjures up bewitching surprises.

episodes.title: Practical Dreams
episodes.summary: Helen navigates a deepening crisis, while Dana Sue challenges her students to spread their culinary wings. An unexpected visitor brings important news.

episodes.title: Abundant Grace
episodes.summary: The Magnolias come together after a personal tragedy. Kyle's online hobby wins him new popularity, and a life-changing secret comes to light.

episodes.title: How Great Thou Art
episodes.summary: The Townsend kids process a sudden revelation. Maddie asserts her boundaries at home, while Helen helps the mayor get ahead of the town's rumor mill.

episodes.title: True North
episodes.summary: Torn between duty and desire, Ty follows his heart. Serenity hunkers down as a massive storm makes landfall. Erik risks everything in the name of love.

episodes.title: Ring That Bell
episodes.summary: Cal and the restaurant staff scramble to feed the town. A viral video puts Maddie in the spotlight. Helen kisses and tells with an extra-spicy story.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.summary: When the Sentinel publishes a hurtful article, Helen's damage control pours fuel on the fire. Back from Ohio, Isaac breaks bread with the Townsends.

episodes.title: Walls and Doors
episodes.summary: Ronnie's behavior worries Dana Sue. Erik reveals his private passion. A new generation of Magnolias hold their first meeting — minus the margaritas.

episodes.title: Dance Your Sugarplum Off
episodes.summary: Cherished holiday traditions, both old and new, brighten the Christmas season for all. Maddie's recent news exposure yields an adventurous opportunity.

episodes.title: Do Not Be Afraid
episodes.summary: Serenity gathers for its annual festival. As relationships blossom and new plans abound, the Magnolias ponder the next chapter in their evolving stories.

episodes.title: The Magnolias Take Manhattan
episodes.summary: Six months after Maddie's move, the Magnolias take a bite out of the Big Apple — and wash it down with margaritas.

episodes.title: Bigger and Brighter
episodes.summary: As Maddie and Cal start new chapters, Dana Sue and Ronnie find themselves on different pages. Helen dusts off an old playbook for her dream wedding.

episodes.title: Never Stop Graduating
episodes.summary: Maddie helps Kyle and company tame a theatrical crisis. Helen gets an unwelcome glimpse of the "Whitley Way." Annie receives bittersweet news from afar.

episodes.title: Swing for the Fences
episodes.summary: The Magnolias shake their pompoms as the Bulldogs take the field for the annual alumni game. Shopping for bridesmaid dresses unearths deep emotions.

episodes.title: Aim Big
episodes.summary: An unexpected opportunity for Cal tests Maddie's faith in the future. Annie's heart is pulled in two directions. Old wounds resurface for Helen and Erik.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: A town tradition proves food and fellowship can brighten the darkest days. Kyle and Lily clash with a co-star. Isaac learns love can thrive off-script.

episodes.title: Same Sky
episodes.summary: A whimsical bridal shower and a brain-teasing bachelor party honor the soon-to-be newlyweds — as a shocking secret shakes another couple's foundation.

episodes.title: Everyday, Every Day
episodes.summary: The Magnolias bring their sparkle to Savannah for a whirlwind bachelorette weekend. Back in Serenity, the Mini Magnolias help Annie narrow the field.

episodes.title: Common Language
episodes.summary: The Magnolias unveil their bold new vision at the revived Art Walk. A face from Cal's past raises uncertainty. Tensions simmer as the Whitleys arrive.

episodes.title: Come Home
episodes.summary: On Helen's wedding day, Maddie and Dana Sue raise a toast to hope, healing, heartbreak and the enduring bonds of friendship.
